lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized in approximately 6-7 longitudinal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a structured pattern of local maxima across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the longitudinal rows of blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes in the central-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal teleost fish swimming in close proximity to the pectoral fin and ventral-lateral body wall.
